scores.evidence: Every screen has a heading, figure, table, code block or check (textOnlyScreens is empty on both widths). The s1-lifecycle flowchart (TD) can be read at 390 px, and its labels are Japanese. Two edge labels sit next to each other and read as one phrase, and the first column of the A/B tables breaks inside words on mobile.

Paragraphs are short, and definitions, tables, code and checks alternate with no walls of text (for example mobile-jp-12 to mobile-jp-18). The practice section is long on mobile: about 9 screens from mobile-jp-19 to mobile-jp-26, with two 15/24-line code blocks and two 6-row tables in a row.

The page is all Japanese, with no stray English UI on the jp screens. Contrast is good on the light cards and the dark code blocks, and the diagram has alt text. On mobile the line breaks 「実行されるも／の」 and 「外とのやり取／り」 split words, and the save path of the practice script is hidden behind an ellipsis.

mustFix.issue: The edge label 「ツールを使う」 (B→C) and the return label 「止める」 (C→B) sit almost touching between the 「Claudeが次の行動を選ぶ」 box and the PreToolUse diamond. They read as one phrase, 「ツールを使う止める」, on both widths.
mustFix.fix: Remove the label from `B --> C` (the PreToolUse diamond already says when this happens) and keep only `C -->|止める（選び直す）| B`. Another option is to label the forward edge 「使う前」 so the two labels no longer join into one phrase.

mustFix.issue: At 390 px the first column breaks inside words: 「実行されるも／の」 and 「外とのやり取／り」. The same happens in practice-b-model-b (mobile-jp-25), and s5-checks shows 「外とのやり／取り」 (mobile-jp-17).
mustFix.fix: Use labels of 4 characters or fewer in all three tables (s5-checks, practice-b-model, practice-b-model-b), for example 「実行内容」 instead of 「実行されるもの」 and 「外部連携」 instead of 「外とのやり取り」. Keep the card-before-install flashcard back in line with the new labels.

mustFix.issue: On mobile the code header cuts the filename to 「.claude/hooks/protect-files.…」, and line 2 is cut at the right edge too. A mobile learner cannot see where to save the script, and the step text p-script only says `protect-files.sh`.
mustFix.fix: In practice-steps item p-script, name the full path: 「`.claude/hooks/protect-files.sh` を作って許可を付け…」. Also shorten the line-2 comment so it fits in about 35 monospace characters, for example `# .envなどへの書き込みを止める`.

niceToHave: Highlighted code lines run past the visible width, so the key part is scrolled out of view: s1-prettier line 9 (`… xargs npx prettier --write`, desktop-jp-04 and mobile-jp-05), s2-settings and practice-model-settings line 9/18 (the script name after `$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR`, desktop-jp-16 and mobile-jp-22), s2-script lines 4 and 7 (mobile-jp-08), and the s4-add comments on lines 5–6 (mobile-jp-15). Consider shorter comments, or a sentence under the block that repeats the important value.

s2-steps and practice-steps titles start with ①②③ while the reader also draws 1/2/3 circles next to them (mobile-jp-09, desktop-jp-14). The circled numbers tie the steps to code comments such as `# ② 実行を許可する`, so either keep them on purpose or drop them from the titles and the comments.
The practice-prompt body shows literal backticks around `.env` (mobile-jp-20, desktop-jp-15). This is fine if it is meant for Claude; otherwise write it as 「.env」.

The keys chip `Ctrl + O` in practice-steps p-claude shows up with no explanation, because the explanation sits in the collapsed hint. Consider adding a few words to the step md (for example 「Ctrl+Oで止まった理由を確かめられます」).
Desktop charsPerLine median is 42 (min 33, max 68), above the 30–40 target. The 680 px measure is set by the reader, so this is not a lesson defect.
reader: the mobile full-length PNG stops at 16000 px (pageHeight 23027). The per-screen PNGs cover the whole lesson.
reader: the end banner says 「このコースの最後のレッスンまで読み終えました」 because drafts are not in course.json (mobile-jp-32, desktop-jp-23).
reader: no scroll cue on code blocks that scroll sideways.
reader: 14 failed /api/ requests (500 on user/progress, events, notifications) are environment noise and are not counted as console errors.
summary: There are no hard failures in metrics.json (no overflow, no console, mermaid, unknown-block or broken-image errors), every screen holds a heading, figure, table, code or check, and no screen I opened shows personal data. Three must-fix items remain. The diagram labels 「ツールを使う」 and 「止める」 run together into one phrase, the A/B checklist tables break words like 「実行されるも／の」 and 「外とのやり取／り」 at 390 px, and on mobile the save path of the practice script is hidden behind an ellipsis.
